proposal_title: Hierarchical Two-Tier GenerationJob Lifecycle State Machine & Stage Mapping
domain_specific_rationale: From the Contracts and API specification perspective, CP-002 resolves a critical ambiguity between coarse-grained database lifecycle status and fine-grained orchestration execution stages. Conflating operational step states with durable aggregate root statuses breaks API consumers that need stable, coarse-grained state transitions. The two-tier specification establishes CanonicalLifecycleStatus (QUEUED, RESERVED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, RECONCILED) as the durable contract enum in domain-entities.schema.json, while defining ExecutionStage (17 granular stages such as WAITING_FOR_ASSETS, PROMPT_READY, BUDGET_RESERVED, SUBMITTING, SUBMITTED, GENERATING, DOWNLOADING, DOWNLOADED, QC_RUNNING, APPROVED, etc.) for telemetry, event envelopes, and orchestrator tracking. The explicit Parent-to-Child mapping matrix and transition table in STATUS_STATE_MACHINES.md define an unambiguous formal state contract that prevents invalid intermediate state emissions and guarantees deterministic contract validation.

residual_risk: Clients or workers might attempt to transition status out of sync with allowed execution stages. Mitigated by R02 Core State contract validation rejecting invalid status/stage combinations based on the normative matrix.
